definition: OMIM #621474 designates neurodevelopmental disorder with congenital cardiac defects and variable renal and ocular abnormalities (NEDCRO), an autosomal dominant condition caused by heterozygous variants in the KDM2B gene (particularly affecting the CxxC zinc-finger domain). It is characterized clinically by neurodevelopmental delay and intellectual disability, accompanied variably by structural ocular malformations, congenital heart defects, and renal anomalies.

source.title: Variants in the CxxC domain of the epigenetic regulator KDM2B support its role in developmental eye anomalies
source.quote: Heterozygous variants in KDM2B were recently associated with a neurodevelopmental disorder. Notably, some individuals with variants in the CxxC domain also exhibited congenital heart, kidney and/or structural eye anomalies.
